result.observation_contract: Side RGB-D, wrist RGB, calibration + robot proprioception ONLY; evaluator results never returned to policy

request.plan: Require a fresh RGB-D observation before motion under this repaired plan. Always use CURRENT evidence. At initial_observation: continue if table_fit_valid is true and blue, red, and green are all visible, regardless of null grasp_confirmed; otherwise reobserve if evidence is missing and observation budget remains, or escalate. Never retry_grasp during initial_observation. At verify_grasp: continue if grasp_confirmed is true; retry_grasp if explicitly false and retries remain; reobserve if null and observation budget remains; otherwise escalate. Escalate conflicting evidence or when no action fits; stop if recovery is unavailable. Preserve budgets and execution code.
